sources.locator: Pages 2,5,12-15: pin table, electrical limits and application design
sources.evidence_extract: AP63201 is the adjustable 500 kHz forced-PWM member. FB limits 0.792-0.808 V apply across -40 to +85 C and 3.8-32 V input. Internal compensation; optional 10-220 pF feedforward; ceramic 22-68 uF output guideline; 100 nF bootstrap. Near-100% dropout operation is described; no maximum high-side resistance is specified.
